# R2.19 — Embed/MCP surface legs — DefinitionInput::Ref, SSE, credential mediator

Ticket `docs/tickets/125_R2.19__embed-mcp-surface-legs.md`
(seq 125). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.18` (PR #125);
ADR-0351. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — the
registry is the embedded snapshot, SSE runs over a loopback
`TcpListener`, and the OAuth leg is the kernel's own
`minted_scoped` issue path; no live provider or TLS endpoint
exists at this slice.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.25-1 · DF-S4.11-1 · DF-S4.11-2 ·
BL-27 · R-2.10.2 · R-2.11.3 · R-2.11.4 · CC1 · CC3 · CC7 · SV-5.

## What landed

**`DefinitionInput::Ref` — the registry-backed publish/fetch
path (DF-S1.25-1 → DONE; ADR-0351 D1–D3).** The embedded
`RegistryStore` is the definition-publishing surface the §03
document plane owns: `resolve_definition` auto-registers every
sealed `Document` open as `RegistryRecord::SealedDefinition`
(idempotent on the content-addressed version id; a registration
failure refuses the open — CC3), and `lab.registry.publish` names
it under `ns/name[@label]`. A `ref` resolves through the one
`base_definition` grammar (`version:<vid>` | bare version id |
`ns/name[@label]` — CC1, no second spelling) under
`ResolveMode::Execute` — the desugar's `base:` read stays `Audit`,
the open path runs the resolved definition so the stricter gates
apply. Version spellings hit the local blob pool first
(`persisted_definition` verifies blob hash + pinned root); a
registry hit re-deposits through the same
blob/`artifacts/`/`sealed_defs` chain — a ref-opened definition
is byte-identical to a document-opened one. Unresolvable refs
stay the typed `UnresolvedRef`.

**The Streamable-HTTP SSE half (DF-S4.11-1 → DONE; ADR-0351
D4).** `serve_http` is now a single-threaded nonblocking
multiplex — `LabServer` is `!Send`, so accept/read/dispatch/push
round-robin on the one `&mut` (no per-conn workers). `GET /mcp`
under a valid session + resolved credential answers `200
content-type: text/event-stream`, replays the retained backlog
after `Last-Event-ID` (absent → tail; malformed → live — never a
guessed cursor; an evicted tail resumes at the head, never a
fabricated replay), then pushes live frames. The one
`push_notification` mint appends to a sequenced binding-scoped
`events` log (`seq` = the `id:` + resume key; `binding_id` scopes
delivery) **and** the legacy `pending` drain — the S5.7/S5.8
POST/stdio consumers (`subscriptions/listen`) see the same
notification, one spelling.

**The WS-H3 credential mediator (DF-S4.11-2 → dated progress;
ADR-0351 D5).** `EmbedService::surface_verify_caller_token`
answers the broker's `MintedVerdict` over `verify_minted`;
`surface_mint_caller_token` is the kernel's own `minted_scoped`
issue path — `granted`/`decided`/`bound`/`used` rows land durable
under the contract run before the token answers, and the token
itself goes to the caller, never into a record. `LabServer::
resolve_credential` composes the grant table with the mediator:
`stdio_launch` unchanged; `oauth{audience}` must verify — a
forged, wrong-audience, expired or revoked token answers its
typed `CredentialRefusal` → `401` (never a fabricated subject);
`mtls` refuses `transport_absent` — no TLS handshake exists at
this slice (BL-31). `MintedVerdict` re-exports through
`hh_embed::service` — `hh-mcp-lab` keeps no `hh-secrets` edge
(the removability gate verifies the S4.11 surface stays a leaf).

## Deferral dispositions

- `DF-S1.25-1` → **DONE** — the embedded registry is the
  publishing surface; `open_session{definition:{ref}}` resolves
  to the pinned sealed definition through all three spellings.
- `DF-S4.11-1` → **DONE** — `GET /mcp` streams
  `text/event-stream`; server-initiated push delivers a
  notification minted after subscription; `Last-Event-ID`
  resumes without loss.
- `DF-S4.11-2` → dated progress, **stays OPEN** — the mediator
  seam resolves `oauth` through the kernel's own AS leg and
  refuses `mtls` honestly; the residual is the environment-gated
  exchange legs (a real OAuth provider's challenge→token
  exchange + the TLS handshake's peer-identity map — BL-31).
- `BL-27` → dated progress, open on the same residual; sources
  += ADR-0351.
- none opened.
